theses.subject: Tech Hardware & Semis
theses.thesis: Despite being unscorable, Tech Hardware & Semis is the highest-ranked eligible theme, supported by the absolute-trend gate (eligibility = true, durability_bar 0.58, trend) which is the one validated risk-control edge. Momentum rank 2 gives focus; the theme is not crowded (crowding_z 0.23), and breadth is narrow (0.167) but concentrated leadership often persists in HK tech. The absolute-trend discipline materially lowers volatility and drawdown – overweighting eligible themes that are also leading in momentum aligns with that edge, even if the theme cannot be directly scored via an ETF.
evidence: eligible = true (absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown/shake-out avoidance)
crowded = false, crowding_z 0.23 (no sizing caution flag)
theses.dissent: The theme's breadth is only 0.167, meaning it is driven by a tiny number of stocks; a reversal in those few names could quickly reverse the entire theme's performance with no broad participation to cushion the fall.
